title: 49 - Arrival
summary: In polar orbit over [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-3|Poseidon]], an all-ocean world whose sea life includes huge tentacled krakens, [[character:mulder]] hosts [[character:marcus]] and [[character:monty]] in his [[technology:vr]], where [[technology:jeeves]] serves coffee and [[character:spike]] gets a scratch. Monty arrives with the first colonists and wakes the setup team, who pick two huge plant mats drifting in the north tropical current, among those Mulder had tagged with beacons, and start ferrying supplies down; colonists from four island communities are to be woken in small groups as living space is built. Floating cities are the long-term plan, and with no land all industry must be in space. When krakens keep killing settlers, Marcus jokes about flying cities built from an [[technology:asteroid-mover]], then adapts plans for an electrified net that adds six months to the schedule and keeps Monty there longer.

introducing.name: Marcus
introducing.description: Supports the first colony on [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-3|Poseidon]] with [[character:mulder]] and will stay on to help set it up after [[character:monty]] leaves. He plans to build a fleet of human-crewed spaceships so the colonists can travel space on their own, and prefers a virtual Coke to coffee.
introducing.current_state: After krakens kill settlers on the colony's mats, he adapts library plans for an electrified net that shocks on contact. Building it adds six months to the schedule, and he goes to break the delay to the colonists.

introducing.name: Monty
introducing.description: The colony transport that carries the first colonists to [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-3|Poseidon]]. The setup teams work from him for a long time while the colony is built, and he is to head home once he can leave.
introducing.current_state: Arrived at Poseidon, he wakes the Setup Management team to begin decanting the colonists. Expecting to be held there about a year, he is now stuck six months longer while the kraken net is built.

introducing.name: Arrival of the first colonists at Poseidon
introducing.description: The arrival of the colony transport [[character:monty]] at [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-3|Poseidon]] with its first colonists, from enclaves of four island regions. Supported by [[character:mulder]] and [[character:marcus]], the setup team chose two plant mats in the north tropical current, ferried supplies down and would wake colonists in small groups as housing rose.

updates.current_state: In polar orbit over [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-3|Poseidon]], he supports its first colony: he had tagged the largest plant mats with beacons, and he works with [[character:marcus]] and [[character:monty]] as krakens attack the settlers and an electrified net is planned.

updates.description: A binary system 19.5 light-years from [[location:epsilon-eridani|Epsilon Eridani]], with the Sun-like [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-a|EC-A]] and [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-b|a long-period companion]]. It has five rocky planets and no Jovians; [[character:mulder]] thinks the companion and the missing Jovian swept it clean. It has no significant asteroid belt and only a few eccentric asteroids, and its metal content, slightly richer than Sol's, lies almost entirely in the planets. Its third planet, [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-3|Poseidon]], now hosts a [[event:poseidon-colony-arrival|human colony]] on floating plant mats.

updates.state: Its first colony is set up on two plant mats in the north tropical current; colonists from Micronesia, the Maldives, Vanuatu and Saint Lucia wake in small groups. Krakens have killed settlers, so a net is planned (six more months). Floating cities will follow; with no land, industry is in space.
updates.description: The habitable-zone third planet of [[location:eta-cassiopeiae]], slightly smaller than Earth, with a 26-hour day, an Earth-like slightly oxygen-rich atmosphere, and a global ocean about 800 km deep. Floating symbiotic plant mats kilometers across produce its oxygen, host animal life, and are exceptionally biocompatible with humans; a rich ecosystem lives below the surface. [[character:mulder]] has suggested the name Poseidon; the planet has four moons, two larger ones about half and a fifth the size of Earth's moon and two small inner rocks. It hosts a human colony on floating plant mats, founded with the [[event:poseidon-colony-arrival|arrival of the first colonists at Poseidon]].
